snippet.title: Ironwing Valiant: Record of Astera - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Ironwing Valiant is a fast-pace, mecha action-JRPG game with shooting and melee mechanics, mech customization, companion customization, real-time with pause command abilities in combat, and a compelling storyline and characters. Taking the guise of a young mecha pilot named Reinhardt, you will battle through sleepy villages, imposing fortress cities, and war-scarred industrial centers, fully customize your Valiant (our term for mecha) to fit your playstyle.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3871670/Ironwing_Valiant_Record_of_Astera/

Meet the Dev (Tiger Team)
